note: Fill the nulls below from the capacity-soak-evidence artifact of one passing 120-minute workflow_dispatch run of app-project-quota-probe.yml (job capacity-soak). Nothing here may cite a pull request smoke run: it is five minutes and is never evidence. Until then OPS-08 stays pending and SEC-09 stays partial.

reference_host.volume: 16 GiB XFS project-quota loop volume created and owned by the job

budgets_reported_by_the_runner.disk_bytes_note: raised from the 8 GiB default to 10 GiB for the run: refused probe installs leave their namespace reserved

backend_sizing.rule: floor((budget - one minimum backend) / 8), computed from the budgets the runner reports in its readiness facts

load.backend_workload: holds 60% of its memory limit, burns its CPU quota, parks threads up to its PID limit minus a margin, writes 1 MiB/s to its log, fills its data namespace to ENOSPC
load.platform_workload: one signed request in flight to each backend, repeated task admission refusals, task backlog to the global quota, an event subscription saturated at its in-flight bound

image_beyond_the_image_store.observed: unit level: a descriptor declares at most 4 GiB; the 10 GiB store needs three real images in the daemon

event_subscription_over_quota.expected: subscription review_required, both source events kept

OPS-08.closes_when: a 120-minute dispatch run passes every assertion above

SEC-09.closes_with: OPS-08: the deployed memory, PID, log and storage floods and the Portal business-path latency measurement

unproven_until_the_dispatch_run: that p95 of GET /api/home, of the report page and of the queue's dispatch decision stay within 1.5x of the idle baseline for two hours on shared CI hardware (the verdict is strict per one-minute window)
that the eight backends, flooding their limits, stay inside the runner's memory and CPU budgets for two hours and none is OOM-killed or restarted
that a refused install can free its data namespace: it cannot (production gap, doc 171 resolution 53); the run raises the runner disk budget to 10 GiB instead
that the per-application task quota (1000) is reached natively; it is proven at its boundary at unit level only
